prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Asset: one existing installed Feudal Lord Simulator game image; non-destructive Wave41 revision.
Input1 is the immutable geometry reference. Edit this image, do not design a different asset.
Retexture the smooth cloud canopy with small readable leaf clumps and broken painterly internal edges, keep original fruit species/color, trunks, every branch position and exact canopy silhouette. Not a species change.
ART_BIBLE_v2: soft hand-painted prerender, muted southern English1300-1450 material palette, upper-left world lighting, no black cartoon outline, no added text/watermark.
Maintain EXACT original canvas aspect 256:256, original transparent padding, anchor/pivot, ground contact, silhouette, perspective and occupied bounds. Do not crop, recenter or rotate. Output exactly one image; no comparison sheet.
Genuine transparent background. All originally empty regions remain transparent.
Input 2 is ONLY a material brushwork reference, never a geometry reference. Preserve Input 1's exact silhouette, occupied bounds and all empty padding. Preserve original fruit color/species and every original trunk and branch; never copy oak shape or species.
Pear foliage: small simple oval pointed leaves, never lobed oak leaves. Do not invent fruit where Input 1 has none.

inspection.evidence: Leaf-clump brush texture replaces cloud fill; original non-foliage RGB, trunks and branch positions retained; original alpha including internal holes unchanged.
inspection.raw_geometry: Model raw contour and branch drift are NOT claimed to pass. Final uses immutable original alpha; trees also use original non-foliage RGB.
limitations: Offline standalone review only; not installed or runtime-tested.
Small preserved original foliage edge areas remain where raw generated alpha was absent; no added fruit.

processing.resize: one full-canvas downsample to original dimensions; no trim, recenter, crop or rotation
processing.alpha: every original alpha byte copied exactly
processing.rgb: foliage-only selection from original G >= R*0.97 and G > B*1.18; original trunks/branches/non-green RGB unchanged; 88% generated RGB + 12% original RGB; original fallback where generated alpha <128
